title: Show a value
summary: A Svelte component can contain a script and page markup.

Explain the example for show a value

blocks.text: A Svelte component can contain a script and page markup. Curly brackets show a JavaScript value in the markup.
Use a Svelte 5 project. Save a single example as App.svelte unless file names say otherwise. The Svelte compiler is required; these snippets do not run as plain HTML or JavaScript.
Read the code step by step

items: The script defines the club text once.
The single-brace expression `{club}` places that value in Svelte markup.

blocks.text: The component shows Reading club as its heading.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: A .svelte file needs the Svelte build tool. A browser cannot use the source file directly.
